newsitem.title: USA: Commerce nominee Daley falls at news conference.
newsitem.headline: Commerce nominee Daley falls at news conference.

text.p: Chicago lawyer William Daley tumbled to the floor on Friday during a news conference at which President Bill Clinton announced he was nominating Daley to be his new commerce secretary.

"I think he's fine, I think he fainted," Clinton said as aides helped Daley out of the room. Daley, 48, appeared to be holding his head as he was led away. He had just concluded remarks saying he was delighted to become part of Clinton's Cabinet.
